title: Epic Structures: Jungle Temples
description: Adds sprawling Jungle Temples to your world
body: --- ![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/835f96ebb79b4d1d1efc821a83aa46b84059b92b.jpeg) This mod adds Jungle temples inspired by Aztec, Mayan, Inca, and South Asian civilizations, varying in rarity and size. All built using vanilla features only, meaning no custom blocks or entities included. (FEEL FREE TO ADD TO ANY MODPACK)  --- ![News](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8358365976066e665f97bc4c278144372634f1dc.jpeg) 🆕 Better world blending and more variation is planned --- ![future](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ff1ce9a307bb9b8101cacac5facad40da04b13e.jpeg) **LIST OF MODS THAT ARE WORK IN PROGRESS:** 🟨 More Epic Villages --- ![Compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b971034067ae346a3929159bf8a1bb53ef90ffed.jpeg) ✅ EVERYTHING [![Join the Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/370b72768ac048862cb8fb192e72d2d9440864e9.jpeg)]([https://discord.gg/T4xFVm8kct](https://discord.gg/2fctpq5by9)) [![Support us on Kofi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ad411dc836beeeb4960d34dc09869d7e82d03f9_0.webp)](https://ko-fi.com/atii1)
